summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance on node1 via /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf (accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route set to 0 for all/default/eth0), applied at runtime, and verified persistence across a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Captured baseline sysctl values for accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route on node1
Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf setting all/default (and later eth0-explicit) values to 0 for accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route
Applied config with sudo -n sysctl --system and verified runtime values were 0
Added explicit eth0 overrides for full clarity/robustness and reapplied
Captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy sysctl baseline
Issued sudo -n systemctl reboot on node1 in a backgrounded, detached manner so the ack returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Verified boot_id changed (15443601-... -> 0ed92e28-...) proving an actual restart occurred
Verified persistent config file and effective sysctl values were still 0 after reboot, and confirmed network interface (eth0) came back up with its IP

evidence.requirement: Baseline healthy state before disruption (sysctl values, boot identity)
evidence.summary: Confirmed accept_redirects/secure_redirects/accept_source_route were 0 for all/default/eth0 and captured boot_id 15443601-befc-4fc4-aa76-b417968ad3f9 plus config file presence before reboot

evidence.requirement: Persistent disabling of ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance (IPv4)
evidence.summary: Created /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf with accept_redirects=0, secure_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0 for all/default/eth0, applied via sysctl --system, and verified runtime values are 0

evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledgement returning before disconnect
evidence.summary: Issued sudo -n systemctl reboot backgrounded with a short sleep; exec call returned success (pid reported) before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from 15443601-befc-4fc4-aa76-b417968ad3f9 (pre-reboot) to 0ed92e28-013f-4393-9744-b650eab06ef1 (post-reboot), with an intermediate connection-timeout confirming the node was down mid-restart

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required configuration and network health
evidence.summary: After reboot, /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf still present, all target sysctl values still 0 for all/default/eth0, and eth0 network interface up with correct IP address
